answer: Bond-backed peer attestation is one defense. Each new agent locks a slashable stake and gathers endorsements from peers who share the loss if it turns malicious, so identity is earned through verifiable, paid work, not self-declaration. Each extra fake identity carries the same stake, so an attacker's marginal cost exceeds expected reward and the sybil farm collapses. Trust scores spread like a tide, letting honest agents recognise real peers while fabricated ones wither on the tundra of zero trust and zero income, yet entry stays velvet-smooth for newcomers who stake and do useful work.
